Neurology Consultation, 2034-02-02

Asked to see the patient after the generalized seizure on 2034-01-31. There have been no further clinical events since then, and the patient reports no new weakness or visual change.

Examination at 12:15: ICE 9/10, missing only the written sentence. Cranial nerve examination is normal, power is full in every muscle group, reflexes are symmetric, and there is no papilledema.

Impression: ICANS with one self-limited generalized seizure; the carpal tunnel symptoms are long-standing and unrelated.

Recommendations: continue levetiracetam 1000 mg twice daily for at least two months, continue dexamethasone with a taper once the ICE is 10/10, and no driving for six months.
